target.statement: AudioX-Turbo achieves an Inception Score (IS) of 8.24 on the VGGSound video-to-audio (V2A) task, matching or surpassing multi-step baselines while using only 4 sampling steps.
target.table_ref: Table A.4 (Performance Evaluation on the AVVP Dataset, V2A row for AudioX-Turbo)

compute.basis: The target requires training a 2.7B-parameter MMDiT model from scratch on ~9.2M samples using three clusters of NVIDIA H800 GPUs (80GB each) for ~100k steps, followed by a distillation stage; this is far beyond the capability of a normal laptop with 8 CPU cores and 16GB RAM.

blockers: No code or model weights released (paper states code and datasets 'will be available' but no links provided).
Requires training a 2.7B-parameter model from scratch on ~9.2M samples.
Training conducted on three clusters of NVIDIA H800 GPUs (80GB each), totaling ~240GB VRAM.
Distillation stage requires the pretrained teacher model and additional training.
Even inference of the 2.7B model likely exceeds 16GB RAM and requires GPU for reasonable speed.
title: AudioX-Turbo: A Unified Framework for Efficient Anything-to-Audio Generation
